job.job_description:
I am currently working with TCS and seeking for an experience AI/GenAI Security engineer

We believe that your skills and expertise are a better match for the skills we are looking for.

Experience Range - 4 to 8 years

Job Description -

4 to 8 years of relevant experience in AI security, application security, penetration testing, red-teaming, vulnerability assessment or offensive security testing for enterprise systems.

Bachelors/Master’s in Computer Science, Cyber Security, AI/ML Security or related discipline.
Hands-on experience applying OWASP application security practices and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications to AI models, prompts, APIs, data pipelines and agentic workflows.
Practical exposure to prompt-injection testing, jailbreak testing, model misuse assessment, sensitive data leakage testing and AI guardrail evaluation.
Experience testing RAG pipelines, retrieval layers, tool calls, API integrations, access controls and model response boundaries.
Understanding of identity, secrets management, least-privilege design, threat modelling, security monitoring and AI incident response.

Preferred certifications include CEH, OSCP/OSCP+, CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500), GIAC AI Platform Security (GAIPS), INE eAIS, or equivalent AI/LLM security certification.

If you are interested and to know more about the opportunity, kindly Apply -

Please forward the same to your friends and colleagues, who are looking for change in Oracle AI/GenAI Security engineer

Looking forward to connect!
